modelRequired: Physical grant names one actual msection incarnation/semispace/layout and contiguous cursor window plus stack interval; exclude chunk link and end markers, require word alignment/checked offset arithmetic, heapHi<=stackLo when sharing, and no conflicting allocator/writer capability; logical global free space, fudge and compile-time reserved counters are not this proof; grant leaves hp unchanged so this profile needs no new sparse/uninitialized-gap scan contract; account initialized prefix plus unused reserved words once, and close/refund only unused capacity, never committed objects

30 conditional interval-fit/disjointness, caller-word arithmetic, stamp equality exclusions, initialized-prefix cursor and ticket/root lifecycle Step/Trace declarations; caller full-view and physical mapping are premises; no complete QNT/C allocator/generator/ABI simulation

Release-publish complete rooted call view before reservation; same atomic registry serializes grant/cancel/enter and GC/layout close; allocation owner and disjoint actual intervals validated before canonical grant, acquire consumer validates server status/epoch/layout/serial/input plus current cursor; last constructor store/initialized prefix and full frame precede lease close and GC admission; collector relocation precedes acquire root reload and new grant; old replies cannot mutate claimed writer permit, stale refund cannot retire new grant; actual C pointer arithmetic/atomics/lock order and helper effects remain open

Canonical noncollecting tryReserve on complete rooted input view is final allocator-layout effect before a no-GC/no-reentry shuffle/repair interval; reserve includes all rest pairs from first CONS plus fallback packet, frame/argument stack and metadata budgets; unused grant cancellation and construction entry share one arbitration; no intervening allocating helper/POLL or legacy heap_limit cursor migration while lease live; initialize objects then advance actual prefix hp, close lease at complete FrameReady before GC

Unused grants must be canonically canceled before GC or allocator layout reassignment, active partial writer must finish full FrameReady and close lease first; flip/reset/reuse invalidates old epoch/layout/serial even at same address; after round/context/binding and root reload, rederive bounds from same stable logical call input and issue new ticket without reevaluating expressions; already completed rest packet needs fresh execution authority, not another rest construction grant

Preflight failure or cancellation retains exact logical target, ordered evaluated arguments/input spine, original continuation and native marker/code/result backing in collector-updateable roots; immutable/version-stable apply input can count then expand, general mutable input requires qualified single-read scan-safe staging, not rereading expressions/list after GC; no GC from existing unframed raw outgoing area; unknown source/input-root closure rejects managed profile

Create rooted CallInputView after operand evaluation; stage an already resolved target only at its allowed resolution point, or use target-independent arity envelope for late-bound global calls, without hoisting observable global reads; establish the view and before destructive expansion/argument relocation, R0 overwrite or native SFUN_ARG stores; dynamic apply cut before POP_ARGS2 and PUSH loop in app after wrapper splice, direct GVM cut before earliest destructive move and with all collecting block checks before final grant, native typed staging before raw outgoing stores and ___call; existing helper entry or late ___call is not a complete caller-view issuer

Known deny keeps complete root view and unchanged allocation cursor; lost grant ACK retains canonical unused grant and query rights, not a second reservation; unknown native allocator/assignment result retains arena transaction debt and cannot become deny/refund by timeout; failed/unknown cancel or entry outcome retains canonical responsibility; caller-input stability, ABI and origin profiles must be qualified, and original arity/error/tail/native return semantics are not replaced by invented pending success

Close new native root borrowers and writers under same registry cut; pre-close writer remains counted through its actual final effect, then materialize matching root generation; relevant borrowed moving values must drain or use admitted stable handles, native-only argv/code/result backing can remain leased; a queued/issued store cannot be revoked by entry closure; late write after receipt invalidates protocol and requires exclusion proof, unknown result retains source duty and blocks receipt

Preflight physically reserves repair words, stack/frame and root/control metadata before pops; close new native writer/borrow admission, settle actual old final effects, complete vector and FrameSpec/GVM writes, release-publish offer, canonical accept/acquire scan; scanner writes release before whole-round/context/binding/acquire reload; exclusive fresh normal/exit claim prevents late scan and duplicate nargs resume; all raw aliases share the cut; no locks held across owner/GC wait; actual C atomic layout, helper visibility and native ABI refinement remain open

FrameReady after full vector initialization, full mapped Scheme call frame, RA/GVM spill, exact root generation and native-frame/capacity lease precedes release-published offer; source pins until canonical VM accept, lost ACK does not restore old authority; one park attempt owns scan/resume/exit arbitration; offer is not scanner permission; no side-effecting rollback or duplicate constructor from unknown acceptance

After scan/root readers drain, whole-round/capacity result, context preparation, same live owner binding and relocated-root reload, claim exactly one normal or exit authority in next epoch; normal branch reloads the same packed vector and proc, restores np arguments, sets nargs=-1 and jumps target, so GET_REST cannot rebuild the rest list; same original native invocation/catcher continues, no replay or helper-thread longjmp

Reserve a construction lease before destructive argument pops; no collecting/reentrant call while partial argument stack/vector lacks complete scan layout; keep partial rest, remaining/required arguments, proc/temp1 and original continuation under exclusive source custody; transfer proc/packed-vector to generated register/frame roots before local scope ends; collector-updateable cells and fresh post-GC handle reload, plus marker/native ancestor roots; all-domain RC/raw alias integration remains open

Source chain GET_REST -> handler7 -> finish remaining CONS -> fully initialize packed vector -> two-argument Scheme helper -> save R0/proc/args and install return frame -> FRAME_STORE_RA/W_ALL -> actual GC; first W_ALL calls noncollecting heap_limit before repair and is ineligible for park; generated RestConstructionPlan binds exact progress, complete-frame PointId/FrameSpec and scan map, not arbitrary partial C stack locals
